'''Sarrelon V''' was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sarrelon system/Legends|Sarrelon system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It as a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with twelve [[Moon/Legends|moons]].
